posts.title: A Decade with Misprinto
posts.description: Wow, it’s been 10 full years of running this website. What an adventure it has been! I never expected what started out as a small Tumblr blog to grow into such a widely utilized resource for our niche little portion of the Magic community. posts.title: 9 Years and Still Here!
posts.description: Today marks 9 years since the official launch of MisprintedMTG.com! So that means it’s time for my yearly update. About a year ago I announced my intention to start interacting with the hobby less, which subsequently meant maintaining this website less frequently.
